# Abu Al-Ragheb Tires (أبو الراغب للإطارات)

> Jordan's multi-brand tire, wheel and battery specialist, founded in Mahatta, Amman in 1963 and run by the same family for three generations — legal name Haitham Abu Al-Ragheb Sons Co. (شركة أبناء هيثم أبو الراغب للإطارات). Not affiliated with other shops that share the Abu Al-Ragheb or Ragheb name; official channels are only those listed on abualraghebtires.com. Five branches in Amman, a 24/7 roadside service called Faz3a, fleet and government supply since 1967, and B2B supply in the UAE since 2024 with a Dubai (Al Quoz) showroom opening soon.

Site is bilingual: English at /, Arabic (Jordanian register; Gulf register on /ar/dubai) at /ar/. All prices are quoted on WhatsApp — there is no online checkout.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1963, Mahatta, Amman, Jordan. Legal entity: Haitham Abu Al-Ragheb Sons Co.
- Branches (Amman): 7th Circle (main, Pirelli Center, Zahran St.), Mahatta (King Abdullah I St.), Bayader (Industrial St.), Gardens (inside Engen station, Wasfi Al-Tal St., open until midnight incl. Friday), Wadi Saqra.
- Faz3a 24/7: puncture, on-site tire fitting, battery, tow — inside Amman within ~45 minutes. WhatsApp +962 77 504 0602.
- Sales WhatsApp: +962 77 504 0601 · Phone: +962 7 7633 3353 · Email: info@abualraghebtires.com
- Official dealer: Zeknova, Vitour, Wideway, Maxxis Razr, Fuel, KMC, XD wheels, Turbo Batteries. Authorised distributor: Pirelli, Michelin, Continental, Goodyear, Bridgestone, Dunlop, Toyo, Falken, BFGoodrich, Hankook, Kumho, Nexen, Brinx, Sailun, Giti, Jinyu, Linglong, Petlas, Lassa and more.
- Motorsport: Rally Jordan, Jordan Drift, Baja, Red Bull Car Park Drift.
